data.heading: How an Adamson system is built

rows.title: Transducers
rows.text: Drivers designed and built in-house. Adamson designs and manufactures its own transducers, so every cabinet starts with parts made for it.

rows.title: Wave shaping
rows.text: Control where the sound goes. Waveguides and enclosure geometry keep coverage even and predictable from the front row to the back.

rows.title: Amplification
rows.text: Power matched to the box. Onboard modules and XG amplifiers are tuned to the loudspeakers they drive.

rows.title: DSP and network
rows.text: Milan from end to end. Processing and Milan AVB networking carry audio, control and monitoring over one connection.

rows.title: Software
rows.text: Design, deploy, diagnose. Blueprint AV and ArrayIntelligence take a system from prediction to show day.

rows.title: Research and development
rows.text: Engineered in Port Perry. Research, testing and manufacturing happen under one roof in Ontario, Canada.
